items.title: New Arrivals From HBX: Maison Kitsuné
items.summary: Brand Information: Maison Kitsuné was launched in 2002 by the creative duo Gildas Loaëc and Masaya Kuroki. The French contemporary fashion brand and music label utilizes the distinct styles of West and East by synthesizing two very different cities - Paris and Tokyo, into its designs. Maison Kitsuné combines classic Parisian minimalism with vibrant Japanese graphics in its collections, with the fox graphic acting as a recurring theme.
